---
title: "About This Portfolio"
---

## Purpose

This site is a personal **playground** for learning the **pharmaverse** - an open-source R ecosystem for clinical trial data analysis - coming from a SAS/SQL background. Expect rough edges: it's a sandbox for experiments, not polished production work.

## Workflow

```
Raw Data (XPT)
    │
    ▼
SDTM (standardized clinical data)
    │
    ▼
ADaM (analysis-ready datasets)  ←── admiral
    │
    ▼
TLFs (Tables, Listings, Figures) ←── rtables + tern + ggplot2
    │
    ▼
Quarto Reports (this site)
```

## Environment

All analyses are run inside the [`statprog_environment/`](https://github.com/brtkl/r_002_pharmaverse_playground/tree/main/statprog_environment) directory, which follows a standard statistical programming folder hierarchy:

| Folder | Contents |
|--------|----------|
| `data/raw/` | Original source data |
| `data/sdtm/` | SDTM datasets |
| `data/adam/` | ADaM datasets (CDISC Pilot) |
| `pgms/` | Analysis programs (R scripts / QMD) |
| `outputs/` | Generated TLF outputs |
| `logs/` | Execution logs |
| `metadata/` | Specifications and data dictionaries |

## Dataset

The **CDISC Pilot Project** dataset is used throughout. It is a publicly available reference dataset distributed by [CDISC](https://www.cdisc.org/) that mirrors a real Phase III Alzheimer's disease clinical trial.
